title: Finding the Tsar's submarine Som and questioning by the Swedish 'FBI'

tellings.quote: wreck we found was 2015. We found the Russian Tsar's submarine, Som. Wow.

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who searches for wrecks in the Baltic Sea, says that in 2015 his team found the wreck of Som, a submarine of the Russian Tsar lost in Swedish waters in the early 1900s, working alongside a man named Peter Lindberg. He tells it firsthand, and says the find led to him being questioned in Stockholm by what he calls the Swedish "FBI", the country's security police.
